_about: Base case inputs. Each input has a value, unit, source, date and flag. Flags: 'sourced' = taken from a cited report or law; 'assumption' = a team judgement to confirm; 'illustrative' = placeholder until the team's sample project numbers replace it. Never present an illustrative value as market data.
project_name: Illustrative Pune residential project (placeholder until the team's sample project is entered)

plot_area_sqft.label: Plot area
plot_area_sqft.source: Placeholder: 1 acre. Replace with the sample project's plot area.

fsi.label: FSI used (incl. premium FSI and TDR)
fsi.source: Placeholder. Check the local development control rules for the plot.

saleable_ratio.label: Saleable area ÷ built-up area
saleable_ratio.source: Placeholder. Use the area basis the sale price is quoted on.

land_price_cr.label: Land price
land_price_cr.source: Placeholder. Replace with the land deal value.

ready_reckoner_cr.label: Ready reckoner value of the land
ready_reckoner_cr.source: Placeholder. Look up the survey number on the IGR Maharashtra eASR portal. 2026-27 rates were reported unchanged from 2025-26, though one report says they were revised; confirm on eASR.

stamp_duty_pct.label: Stamp duty + registration
stamp_duty_pct.unit: % of the higher of land price and ready reckoner value
stamp_duty_pct.source: Assumption. Confirm the rate for this property with IGR Maharashtra.

approvals_cr.label: Approval and scrutiny fees
approvals_cr.source: Placeholder. Replace with the municipal fee schedule for the project.

premiums_cr.label: Premiums (FSI, fungible, TDR)
premiums_cr.source: Placeholder. Premiums are a large cost in Mumbai especially; take them from the authority's demand notes or rates.

construction_rate_psf.label: Construction cost (today)
construction_rate_psf.source: ANAROCK average for a standard-plus residential project, top 7 cities, 2025 (reported by Free Press Journal, 5 Sep 2026).

construction_start_q.label: Construction starts in quarter
construction_start_q.source: Placeholder: after about 3 quarters of approvals.

construction_quarters.label: Construction duration (planned)
construction_quarters.source: Placeholder: 3 years for a mid-rise tower.

launch_q.label: Sales launch in quarter
launch_q.source: Placeholder: launch after RERA registration, with construction start.

price_psf.label: Sale price at launch (net of GST)
price_psf.source: Knight Frank, India Real Estate H1 2026: Pune average residential price. Adjust for the project's micro-market.

price_growth_pct.label: Sale price growth
price_growth_pct.source: Knight Frank, India Real Estate H1 2026: Pune prices +5% year on year.

sales_pace_pct.label: Sales pace
sales_pace_pct.unit: % of saleable area sold per quarter
sales_pace_pct.source: Assumption. For context, Knight Frank puts Pune's unsold stock at 4.5 quarters to sell (market level, H1 2026).

booking_pct.label: Paid at booking
booking_pct.source: RERA Act 2016, Section 13: no more than 10% before a registered agreement for sale.

possession_pct.label: Paid at possession
possession_pct.source: Assumption. The rest is paid in step with construction progress.

escrow_pct.label: Share of collections into the RERA account
escrow_pct.source: RERA Act 2016, Section 4(2)(l)(D). Kept as an input because states can vary it; confirm the state rule.

delay_q.label: Construction delay
delay_q.source: Scenario input. 0 in the base case.

buyer_interest_pct.label: Interest owed to buyers for late possession
buyer_interest_pct.source: Assumption. RERA Section 18 makes the developer pay interest for each month of delay. Many state rules set the rate at SBI's highest MCLR + 2%; confirm the current figure in the state RERA rules.

tax_rate_pct.label: Corporate income tax
tax_rate_pct.source: Section 115BAA rate (22% × 1.10 × 1.04) from the CE725 taxation lecture. Confirm against the Income Tax Act before use.

equity_limit_cr.label: Equity available
equity_limit_cr.source: Placeholder. Equity funds deficits first, up to this amount.

loan_limit_cr.label: Construction loan sanctioned
loan_limit_cr.source: Placeholder. Replace with the lender's sanction.

loan_rate_pct.label: Construction loan interest
loan_rate_pct.source: Assumption. No current published construction-finance rate was found; replace with a bank or NBFC term sheet.

hurdle_rate_pct.label: Project hurdle rate (discount rate)
hurdle_rate_pct.source: Assumption [VALIDATE]. One source cites 12–18% for residential projects.

min_profit_on_cost_pct.label: Minimum profit on cost for a Go
min_profit_on_cost_pct.source: Assumption [VALIDATE]: which go/no-go rule the developer actually uses.
